exposure: prolonged preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPPROM)
Prenatal exposure to a non-sterile intrauterine environment (prolonged preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPPROM) and chorioamnionitis exposure)
outcome: Diversity and bacterial composition of stool microbiota
finding: Maternal complications, particularly exposure to a non-sterile intrauterine environment, significantly influence the diversity and composition of the stool microbiota in premature infants, with findings persisting over time.
mod_finding: Vaginally delivered infants had significantly lower diversity of stool microbiota across all time points compared to those delivered by Caesarean section.
